**Finding: compliant — no redline proposed.**

§ 14.1 gives this Agreement a single fixed Term (Effective Date until the earlier of termination under § 14.2 or payment of the last Approval Payment). Searches for "renew", "automatically renew" and "Renewal Term" surface no auto-renewal, non-renewal notice window, or renewal price-uplift mechanic — the only hits concern IP registration renewals, lien refinancing and insurance coverage. With no evergreen extension, any continuation would require mutual written agreement, which is the playbook's preferred position, and none of the walk-away features (multi-year auto-renewal, >90-day notice window) appear. PB's exit rights sit in the termination provisions (including at-will termination under § 14.2.2), not in a renewal mechanic.
